xids, if non-null, must point to n IDs to assign; if null, IDs are typically assigned sequentially—consult implementation.
n may be zero; otherwise codes_in must be non-null.
Dimensionality must match the index’s d.

functions.name: faiss::IndexFlatPanorama::permute_entries
functions.signature: void faiss::IndexFlatPanorama::permute_entries(const idx_t* perm);
functions.description: Applies a permutation to internal storage entries, reordering database vectors according to perm.
requirements: perm must be a valid permutation array of length ntotal mapping old indices to new positions.
perm must not contain duplicates and must cover all indices 0..(ntotal-1).
Pointer perm must be non-null when ntotal > 0.

functions.name: faiss::IndexFlatL2Panorama::IndexFlatL2Panorama
functions.signature: explicit faiss::IndexFlatL2Panorama::IndexFlatL2Panorama(idx_t d, size_t n_levels, size_t batch_size = 512);
functions.description: Constructs an L2-only Panorama flat index with given dimensionality, number of levels, and optional batch size (default 512).
requirements: d must match vectors’ dimensionality.
n_levels must be >= 1.
batch_size must be >= 1.
Index is empty after construction; add vectors before searching.

functions.name: faiss::IndexFlat1D::IndexFlat1D
functions.signature: explicit faiss::IndexFlat1D::IndexFlat1D(bool continuous_update = true);
functions.description: Constructs a 1D-optimized flat L2 index with optional continuous permutation maintenance. When continuous_update is false, you must manually update the permutation before search.
requirements: continuous_update controls whether internal ordering is maintained as vectors are added.
If continuous_update is false, callers must invoke update_permutation() between the last add and the first search.

functions.name: faiss::IndexFlat1D::update_permutation
functions.signature: void faiss::IndexFlat1D::update_permutation();
functions.description: Builds or refreshes the sorted index permutation used by 1D searches. Required when continuous_update is false.
requirements: Should be called after all intended adds and before the first search when continuous_update == false.
Safe to call multiple times; recomputes the permutation from current data.

functions.name: faiss::IndexFlat1D::add
functions.signature: void faiss::IndexFlat1D::add(idx_t n, const float* x) override;
functions.description: Adds n 1D vectors to the index, optionally updating the internal sorted permutation depending on continuous_update.
requirements: x must point to an array of size n * d floats; for 1D use, d is expected to be 1.
Pointer x must be non-null unless n == 0.
If continuous_update is false, call update_permutation() after the final add and before search.

functions.name: faiss::IndexFlat1D::reset
functions.signature: void faiss::IndexFlat1D::reset() override;
functions.description: Clears all stored 1D vectors and resets internal permutation/state.
requirements: After reset, previous permutation and any raw data pointers become invalid.
Safe to call even when already empty.

functions.name: faiss::IndexFlat1D::search
functions.signature: void faiss::IndexFlat1D::search(idx_t n, const float* x, idx_t k, float* distances, idx_t* labels, const SearchParameters* params = nullptr) const override;
functions.description: Performs k-NN search optimized for 1D data. Note: the distances returned are L1, not L2, as explicitly documented.
requirements: x must be an array of size n * d (for 1D, d == 1).
distances must be an array of size n * k.
labels must be an array of size n * k.
k must be >= 1; typically k <= ntotal.
If continuous_update == false, update_permutation() must have been called after the last add and before this search.
Pointers must be non-null unless n == 0.

functions.name: faiss::Level1Quantizer::train_q1
functions.signature: void faiss::Level1Quantizer::train_q1(size_t n, const float* x, bool verbose, MetricType metric_type)
functions.description: Trains the level-1 (coarse) quantizer and then trains any sub-quantizers via train_residual. Intended to prepare the IVF coarse quantizer before data is added. Behavior depends on quantizer_trains_alone and cp/clustering_index settings.
requirements: x must point to n training vectors of dimensionality matching the attached quantizer’s d (unknown in this header).
quantizer must be non-null and properly initialized before calling.
metric_type should match the intended distance for the IVF system.
If quantizer_trains_alone == 1, the quantizer’s train() is called directly; otherwise k-means is used (per comments).

functions.name: faiss::Level1Quantizer::coarse_code_size
functions.signature: size_t faiss::Level1Quantizer::coarse_code_size() const
functions.description: Returns the number of bytes required to store list identifiers produced by the coarse quantizer (e.g., the storage size of a list id).
requirements: nlist must be set appropriately to reflect the number of lists; returned size depends on nlist.
No side effects; callable anytime after nlist is known.

functions.name: faiss::Level1Quantizer::encode_listno
functions.signature: void faiss::Level1Quantizer::encode_listno(idx_t list_no, uint8_t* code) const
functions.description: Encodes an inverted-list index (list_no) into its byte representation suitable for storage alongside codes when include_listno is used.
requirements: code must point to a buffer of at least coarse_code_size() bytes.
list_no must be a valid list id in [0, nlist) (−1 handling not specified for this method).
nlist must be initialized.

functions.name: faiss::Level1Quantizer::decode_listno
functions.signature: idx_t faiss::Level1Quantizer::decode_listno(const uint8_t* code) const
functions.description: Decodes a previously encoded list identifier from its byte representation back to an inverted-list index.
requirements: code must point to at least coarse_code_size() bytes that were produced by encode_listno().
nlist must match the encoding context used to produce code.

functions.name: faiss::SearchParametersIVF::~SearchParametersIVF
functions.signature: virtual faiss::SearchParametersIVF::~SearchParametersIVF()
functions.description: Destructor for IVF-specific search parameters. Cleans up any derived-class resources (if any).
requirements: If quantizer_params or inverted_list_context point to external objects, ownership and lifetime are managed by the caller unless a derived class overrides this.
Safe to delete via base-class pointer (virtual).

functions.name: faiss::IndexIVFInterface::search_preassigned
functions.signature: virtual void faiss::IndexIVFInterface::search_preassigned(idx_t n, const float* x, idx_t k, const idx_t* assign, const float* centroid_dis, float* distances, idx_t* labels, bool store_pairs, const IVFSearchParameters* params = nullptr, IndexIVFStats* stats = nullptr) const = 0
functions.description: Searches pre-quantized queries using the provided coarse assignments and centroid distances, and fills the top-k heaps. Implementations typically scan only the specified inverted lists via InvertedListScanners.
requirements: x must contain n query vectors of dimension matching the index’s d.
k >= 1; distances and labels must have space for n*k outputs.
assign must contain n*nprobe coarse list ids as produced by the IVF quantizer; nprobe comes from params or the object’s nprobe.
centroid_dis must contain n*nprobe distances corresponding to assign, or may be ignored by some implementations.
If store_pairs is true, labels should store (list_no, offset) packed into the 64-bit id (upper/lower 32 bits) instead of database ids.
params may override nprobe/max_codes; can be null to use object defaults.
stats can be null; if non-null, it is updated.

functions.name: faiss::IndexIVFInterface::range_search_preassigned
functions.signature: virtual void faiss::IndexIVFInterface::range_search_preassigned(idx_t nx, const float* x, float radius, const idx_t* keys, const float* coarse_dis, RangeSearchResult* result, bool store_pairs = false, const IVFSearchParameters* params = nullptr, IndexIVFStats* stats = nullptr) const = 0
functions.description: Performs range search for pre-quantized queries within a given radius using provided list assignments and centroid distances, writing matches to RangeSearchResult.
requirements: x must contain nx query vectors of dimension matching the index’s d.
radius must be non-negative (typical expectation; not explicitly stated).
keys must contain nx*nprobe list ids; nprobe from params or object.
coarse_dis must contain nx*nprobe distances corresponding to keys, or may be unused depending on implementation.
result must be a valid RangeSearchResult to collect outputs.
If store_pairs is true, returned labels are (list_no, offset) pairs instead of ids.
params can be null to use defaults; stats optional and may be null.

functions.name: faiss::IndexIVFInterface::~IndexIVFInterface
functions.signature: virtual faiss::IndexIVFInterface::~IndexIVFInterface()
functions.description: Virtual destructor for the IVF interface. Ensures proper cleanup via base pointers.
requirements: Safe to destroy derived classes through this interface pointer.

functions.name: faiss::IndexIVF::IndexIVF
functions.signature: faiss::IndexIVF::IndexIVF(Index* quantizer, size_t d, size_t nlist, size_t code_size, MetricType metric = METRIC_L2, bool own_invlists = true)
functions.description: Constructs an IVF index with a given coarse quantizer, dimensionality, number of inverted lists, and per-vector code size. Optionally sets the metric and whether the index owns its inverted lists.
requirements: quantizer must implement the coarse assignment over dimension d.
nlist > 0; code_size > 0.
metric must be compatible with the rest of the pipeline.
If own_invlists is true, the index will deallocate its InvertedLists when replaced or destroyed.

functions.name: faiss::IndexIVF::IndexIVF
functions.signature: faiss::IndexIVF::IndexIVF()
functions.description: Default constructor for an IVF index. Initializes members to defaults; a quantizer and training are required before adding/searching.
requirements: Before use, set a quantizer and call train() as needed.
Other members like invlists may be set later or default to ArrayInvertedLists after training (per class docs).

functions.name: faiss::IndexIVF::reset
functions.signature: void faiss::IndexIVF::reset()
functions.description: Clears the index contents (codes/ids) but keeps the structure and training state. Overrides Index::reset.
requirements: Safe to call anytime after construction; index becomes empty afterward.
Does not untrain the quantizer.

functions.name: faiss::IndexIVF::train
functions.signature: void faiss::IndexIVF::train(idx_t n, const float* x)
functions.description: Trains the quantizer and sub-encoders for the IVF index. If by_residual is true, sub-encoders are trained on residuals; otherwise on raw vectors.
requirements: x must contain n training vectors of dimension d.
Must be called before add() unless the index/quantizer are already trained.
May use internal clustering parameters cp and clustering_index from Level1Quantizer.

functions.name: faiss::IndexIVF::add
functions.signature: void faiss::IndexIVF::add(idx_t n, const float* x)
functions.description: Adds n vectors to the index, assigning ids automatically. Calls add_with_ids with null ids.
requirements: Index must be trained.
x must contain n vectors of dimension d.
Automatic id assignment follows the Index base behavior (contiguous ids starting from ntotal).

functions.name: faiss::IndexIVF::add_with_ids
functions.signature: void faiss::IndexIVF::add_with_ids(idx_t n, const float* x, const idx_t* xids)
functions.description: Adds n vectors with user-provided ids to the IVF index. Default implementation delegates code extraction to encode_vectors and inserts into inverted lists.
requirements: Index must be trained.
x must contain n vectors of dimension d.
xids must provide n ids; ids should be unique within the index (typical expectation; not explicitly guaranteed here).
If direct_map is maintained, entries are updated accordingly.

functions.name: faiss::IndexIVF::add_core
functions.signature: virtual void faiss::IndexIVF::add_core(idx_t n, const float* x, const idx_t* xids, const idx_t* precomputed_idx, void* inverted_list_context = nullptr)
functions.description: Core implementation of vector addition when list assignments are already computed. Default implementation extracts codes via encode_vectors and inserts them into the specified lists.
requirements: Index must be trained.
x must contain n vectors of dimension d.
xids may be null if ids are assigned automatically; otherwise n ids.
precomputed_idx must contain n coarse list ids (one per vector).
inverted_list_context is passed to InvertedLists and may be null.

functions.name: faiss::IndexIVF::encode_vectors
functions.signature: virtual void faiss::IndexIVF::encode_vectors(idx_t n, const float* x, const idx_t* list_nos, uint8_t* codes, bool include_listno = false) const = 0
functions.description: Encodes n input vectors into their list-specific codes as stored in inverted lists. If include_listno is true, list identifiers are prefixed/embedded into the output codes.
requirements: x must contain n vectors of dimension d.
list_nos must provide n list ids (−1 entries are ignored).
codes must have room for n*code_size bytes, plus extra if include_listno is true (ceil(log8(nlist)) bytes each).
Behavior for list_nos == −1: code is ignored (per comment).

functions.name: faiss::IndexIVF::decode_vectors
functions.signature: virtual void faiss::IndexIVF::decode_vectors(idx_t n, const uint8_t* codes, const idx_t* list_nos, float* x) const
functions.description: Decodes n codes as they would appear in the given inverted lists into approximate reconstructed vectors (inverse of encode_vectors).
requirements: codes must contain n entries of size code_size each (layout as produced by encode_vectors without include_listno).
list_nos must provide n list ids corresponding to the codes.
x must have room for n*d floats.

functions.name: faiss::IndexIVF::add_sa_codes
functions.signature: void faiss::IndexIVF::add_sa_codes(idx_t n, const uint8_t* codes, const idx_t* xids)
functions.description: Adds precomputed standalone codec codes and their ids into the index without re-encoding. The code format is the standalone form returned by sa_encode/sa_code_size.
requirements: Index must be trained and compatible with the standalone code format.
codes must contain n entries of size sa_code_size() bytes.
xids must contain n ids.
The standalone codes must include any required list id if applicable.

functions.name: faiss::IndexIVF::train_encoder
functions.signature: virtual void faiss::IndexIVF::train_encoder(idx_t n, const float* x, const idx_t* assign)
functions.description: Trains the sub-encoder used to produce per-vector codes. If by_residual is true, training is on residuals using assign; otherwise on raw vectors with assign == nullptr.
requirements: x must contain n training vectors of dimension d.
If by_residual is true, assign must provide the corresponding list assignments for x; otherwise assign should be nullptr.

functions.name: faiss::IndexIVF::train_encoder_num_vectors
functions.signature: virtual idx_t faiss::IndexIVF::train_encoder_num_vectors() const
functions.description: Returns the number of vectors required to train the encoder (hint for upstream training logic).
requirements: Callable before training to size training sets appropriately. Exact policy depends on subclass.

functions.name: faiss::IndexIVF::search_preassigned
functions.signature: void faiss::IndexIVF::search_preassigned(idx_t n, const float* x, idx_t k, const idx_t* assign, const float* centroid_dis, float* distances, idx_t* labels, bool store_pairs, const IVFSearchParameters* params = nullptr, IndexIVFStats* stats = nullptr) const
functions.description: Implementation of IVF search when coarse assignments and centroid distances are provided. Uses InvertedListScanners to scan only the specified lists and writes top-k results.
requirements: x must contain n query vectors of dimension d.
assign and centroid_dis must contain n*nprobe entries; nprobe from params or object’s nprobe.
distances and labels must each have n*k entries.
If store_pairs is true, labels store (list_no, offset) instead of ids.
params/stats are optional and may be null.

functions.name: faiss::IndexIVF::range_search_preassigned
functions.signature: void faiss::IndexIVF::range_search_preassigned(idx_t nx, const float* x, float radius, const idx_t* keys, const float* coarse_dis, RangeSearchResult* result, bool store_pairs = false, const IVFSearchParameters* params = nullptr, IndexIVFStats* stats = nullptr) const
functions.description: Implementation of IVF range search using precomputed coarse assignments and distances. Populates RangeSearchResult with all matches within radius.
requirements: x must contain nx query vectors of dimension d.
keys and coarse_dis must contain nx*nprobe entries; nprobe from params or object.
radius should be >= 0 (conventional).
result must be valid and initialized.
If store_pairs is true, labels are (list_no, offset) pairs.

functions.name: faiss::IndexIVF::search
functions.signature: void faiss::IndexIVF::search(idx_t n, const float* x, idx_t k, float* distances, idx_t* labels, const SearchParameters* params = nullptr) const
functions.description: Assigns queries to coarse lists then searches the selected inverted lists for top-k nearest neighbors. Wrapper that computes assignments then calls search_preassigned.
requirements: x must contain n query vectors of dimension d.
distances and labels must each hold n*k entries.
params may be null or an IVFSearchParameters to override nprobe/max_codes.

functions.name: faiss::IndexIVF::range_search
functions.signature: void faiss::IndexIVF::range_search(idx_t n, const float* x, float radius, RangeSearchResult* result, const SearchParameters* params = nullptr) const
functions.description: Assigns queries to coarse lists then performs range search to collect all neighbors within the given radius. Wrapper around range_search_preassigned.
requirements: x must contain n query vectors of dimension d.
radius should be >= 0 (conventional).
result must be a valid RangeSearchResult to receive outputs.
params may be null or IVFSearchParameters.

functions.name: faiss::IndexIVF::get_InvertedListScanner
functions.signature: virtual faiss::InvertedListScanner* faiss::IndexIVF::get_InvertedListScanner(bool store_pairs = false, const IDSelector* sel = nullptr, const IVFSearchParameters* params = nullptr) const
functions.description: Creates an InvertedListScanner configured for this index to scan list codes for a single query. If store_pairs is true, the scanner records list positions instead of labels; sel restricts matches to a subset of ids.
requirements: Caller owns and must delete the returned scanner unless otherwise documented by implementation.
sel may be null for no filtering.
params may be null; internal logic may override sel compared to params->sel.

functions.name: faiss::IndexIVF::reconstruct
functions.signature: void faiss::IndexIVF::reconstruct(idx_t key, float* recons) const
functions.description: Reconstructs an approximate vector for a stored id. Works only if a direct_map is maintained (maintain_direct_map set to 1 or 2).
requirements: direct_map must be initialized and consistent with the current inverted lists.
recons must have space for d floats.
key must exist in the index; behavior for missing ids is unspecified here.

functions.name: faiss::IndexIVF::update_vectors
functions.signature: virtual void faiss::IndexIVF::update_vectors(int nv, const idx_t* idx, const float* v)
functions.description: Updates the values of a subset of vectors in-place. Requires a direct_map to locate existing entries.
requirements: Index must have a direct_map set (maintain_direct_map true).
idx must contain nv vector ids to update.
v must contain nv vectors of dimension d with new values.

functions.name: faiss::IndexIVF::reconstruct_n
functions.signature: void faiss::IndexIVF::reconstruct_n(idx_t i0, idx_t ni, float* recons) const
functions.description: Reconstructs a range of vectors [i0, i0+ni) without relying on reconstruct() that requires a direct_map. Overrides base to bypass that requirement.
requirements: recons must have space for ni*d floats.
Indices in the range should be present in the index; behavior for missing entries unspecified.

functions.name: faiss::IndexIVF::search_and_reconstruct
functions.signature: void faiss::IndexIVF::search_and_reconstruct(idx_t n, const float* x, idx_t k, float* distances, idx_t* labels, float* recons, const SearchParameters* params = nullptr) const
functions.description: Performs a top-k search and also reconstructs the stored vectors (or approximations) for the returned results. Uses store_pairs in search_preassigned to fetch code offsets without maintaining a direct_map.
requirements: x must contain n query vectors of dimension d.
distances, labels must each have n*k entries; recons must have n*k*d floats.
params may be null or IVFSearchParameters.

functions.name: faiss::IndexIVF::search_and_return_codes
functions.signature: void faiss::IndexIVF::search_and_return_codes(idx_t n, const float* x, idx_t k, float* distances, idx_t* labels, uint8_t* recons, bool include_listno = false, const SearchParameters* params = nullptr) const
functions.description: Performs a top-k search and returns the stored codes for each result instead of reconstructed vectors. Optionally embeds list ids into the returned codes.
requirements: x must contain n query vectors of dimension d.
distances, labels must each have n*k entries.
recons must point to space for n*k*code_size bytes, plus extra bytes per code if include_listno is true.
params may be null or IVFSearchParameters.

functions.name: faiss::IndexIVF::reconstruct_from_offset
functions.signature: virtual void faiss::IndexIVF::reconstruct_from_offset(int64_t list_no, int64_t offset, float* recons) const
functions.description: Reconstructs a vector given its location specified by (inverted-list index, offset) rather than global id. Useful when direct_map is not maintained and offsets were obtained via store_pairs.
requirements: list_no must be a valid list index in [0, nlist).
offset must be a valid element position within the specified list.
recons must have space for d floats.

functions.name: faiss::IndexIVF::remove_ids
functions.signature: size_t faiss::IndexIVF::remove_ids(const IDSelector& sel)
functions.description: Removes all vectors whose ids satisfy the selector from the index’s inverted lists. Returns the number of removed vectors.
requirements: sel defines which ids to remove; must be valid during the call.
May invalidate direct_map entries; implementation is expected to keep structures consistent.

functions.name: faiss::IndexIVF::check_compatible_for_merge
functions.signature: void faiss::IndexIVF::check_compatible_for_merge(const Index& otherIndex) const
functions.description: Checks that another index is compatible for merging into this one (same coarse quantizer and configuration). May perform an expensive check depending on global settings.
requirements: otherIndex must be an IVF-type index with compatible configuration (coarse quantizer, dimensions, code format).
Throws or asserts on incompatibility (behavior unspecified here).

functions.name: faiss::IndexIVF::merge_from
functions.signature: virtual void faiss::IndexIVF::merge_from(Index& otherIndex, idx_t add_id)
functions.description: Merges the dataset from another index into this one, offsetting ids by add_id. Assumes compatibility checked beforehand.
requirements: otherIndex must be compatible; typically call check_compatible_for_merge() first.
add_id is added to source ids to avoid collisions.
After merge, otherIndex may be modified (implementation-defined).

functions.name: faiss::IndexIVF::get_CodePacker
functions.signature: virtual faiss::CodePacker* faiss::IndexIVF::get_CodePacker() const
functions.description: Creates and returns a CodePacker instance suitable for this index. Used to pack/unpack list codes.
requirements: Caller owns and must delete the returned CodePacker, unless documented otherwise by implementation.

functions.name: faiss::IndexIVF::copy_subset_to
functions.signature: virtual void faiss::IndexIVF::copy_subset_to(faiss::IndexIVF& other, InvertedLists::subset_type_t subset_type, idx_t a1, idx_t a2) const
functions.description: Copies a subset of entries from this index to another IVF index. The subset semantics are defined by InvertedLists::copy_subset_to and subset_type.
requirements: other must be an initialized IVF index compatible with this one.
subset_type must be a valid value for InvertedLists::copy_subset_to.
a1 and a2 define the subset range/parameters per subset_type.

functions.name: faiss::IndexIVF::~IndexIVF
functions.signature: virtual faiss::IndexIVF::~IndexIVF()
functions.description: Destructor for the IVF index. Frees owned inverted lists and other resources.
requirements: If own_invlists is true, invlists is deallocated on destruction.
Safe to delete via base pointer (virtual).

functions.name: faiss::IndexIVF::get_list_size
functions.signature: size_t faiss::IndexIVF::get_list_size(size_t list_no) const
functions.description: Returns the number of entries in the specified inverted list.
requirements: list_no must be a valid list index in [0, nlist).

functions.name: faiss::IndexIVF::check_ids_sorted
functions.signature: bool faiss::IndexIVF::check_ids_sorted() const
functions.description: Checks whether ids within inverted lists are sorted. Useful for validating assumptions or enabling optimizations.
requirements: Index must have invlists set; behavior unspecified if invlists is null.

functions.name: faiss::IndexIVF::make_direct_map
functions.signature: void faiss::IndexIVF::make_direct_map(bool new_maintain_direct_map = true)
functions.description: Initializes or clears the direct map that enables id-to-(list,offset) lookups for reconstruct() and updates. If new_maintain_direct_map is false, clears any existing map.
requirements: When enabling, the current contents of the index are scanned to build the map (implementation-defined cost).
Must be called before reconstruct() or update_vectors() if those require a direct map.

functions.name: faiss::IndexIVF::set_direct_map_type
functions.signature: void faiss::IndexIVF::set_direct_map_type(DirectMap::Type type)
functions.description: Sets the strategy used by the direct map (e.g., Hashtable or Array).
requirements: A direct map should be (re)built or consistent with the chosen type; caller typically calls make_direct_map() after changing type.

functions.name: faiss::IndexIVF::replace_invlists
functions.signature: void faiss::IndexIVF::replace_invlists(InvertedLists* il, bool own = false)
functions.description: Replaces the current inverted lists backend with another implementation. Optionally takes ownership of the new lists.
requirements: il must be a valid InvertedLists instance compatible with current data layout.
If own is true, the index will delete il on destruction or when replaced again.
If previous invlists were owned (own_invlists true), they are deallocated.

functions.name: faiss::IndexIVF::sa_code_size
functions.signature: size_t faiss::IndexIVF::sa_code_size() const
functions.description: Returns the number of bytes per vector for the standalone codec representation used by sa_encode/add_sa_codes.
requirements: Index must be trained such that standalone codec parameters are defined.

functions.name: faiss::IndexIVF::sa_encode
functions.signature: void faiss::IndexIVF::sa_encode(idx_t n, const float* x, uint8_t* bytes) const
functions.description: Encodes n vectors using the standalone codec form. Internally calls encode_vectors with include_listno=true. Returns the number of bytes written via contract; here it writes into bytes buffer.
requirements: x must contain n vectors of dimension d.
bytes must have enough space for n*sa_code_size() bytes.
Index must be trained.

functions.name: faiss::InvertedListScanner::InvertedListScanner
functions.signature: faiss::InvertedListScanner::InvertedListScanner(bool store_pairs = false, const IDSelector* sel = nullptr)
functions.description: Constructs a scanner used to traverse codes in specific inverted lists for a single query. Can optionally store list positions instead of ids and filter by an IDSelector.
requirements: store_pairs selects whether to output (list_no, offset) pairs.
sel may be null to disable id filtering.

functions.name: faiss::InvertedListScanner::set_query
functions.signature: virtual void faiss::InvertedListScanner::set_query(const float* query_vector) = 0
functions.description: Sets the query vector for the scanner so that subsequent distance computations refer to this query.
requirements: query_vector must point to a vector of dimension d expected by the index.
Must be called before scanning codes.

functions.name: faiss::InvertedListScanner::set_list
functions.signature: virtual void faiss::InvertedListScanner::set_list(idx_t list_no, float coarse_dis) = 0
functions.description: Informs the scanner that following codes come from a specific inverted list and provides the coarse centroid distance used by some scoring schemes.
requirements: list_no must be a valid list index.
Call before scanning codes from that list.
coarse_dis should be the distance from the query to the list’s centroid.

functions.name: faiss::InvertedListScanner::distance_to_code
functions.signature: virtual float faiss::InvertedListScanner::distance_to_code(const uint8_t* code) const = 0
functions.description: Computes the distance between the current query and a single encoded code from an inverted list.
requirements: set_query() must have been called.
code must point to a valid code of size code_size for this scanner/index.

functions.name: faiss::InvertedListScanner::scan_codes
functions.signature: virtual size_t faiss::InvertedListScanner::scan_codes(size_t n, const uint8_t* codes, const idx_t* ids, float* distances, idx_t* labels, size_t k) const
functions.description: Scans n codes, computing distances to the current query and updating a top-k heap (distances and labels). Default implementation iterates calling distance_to_code.
requirements: set_query() and set_list() should have been called appropriately.
codes must contain n codes of size code_size each.
ids must contain n ids unless store_pairs is true, in which case ids are ignored.
distances and labels represent a heap of size k to be updated; must be initialized appropriately prior to call.
Returns the number of heap updates performed.

functions.name: faiss::InvertedListScanner::iterate_codes
functions.signature: virtual size_t faiss::InvertedListScanner::iterate_codes(InvertedListsIterator* iterator, float* distances, idx_t* labels, size_t k, size_t& list_size) const
functions.description: Iterates codes via an InvertedListsIterator and updates a top-k heap for the current query. Similar to scan_codes but pulls codes from an iterator.
requirements: iterator must be positioned for the desired list and valid during the call.
distances and labels represent a heap of size k; must be initialized.
list_size is set to the number of items scanned in the current list.

functions.name: faiss::InvertedListScanner::scan_codes_range
functions.signature: virtual void faiss::InvertedListScanner::scan_codes_range(size_t n, const uint8_t* codes, const idx_t* ids, float radius, RangeQueryResult& result) const
functions.description: Scans n codes and appends any items whose distance to the query falls below radius to the range-search result. Default implementation may be unimplemented (comment: default fails).
requirements: set_query() and set_list() should have been called.
codes must contain n codes of size code_size each.
ids must contain n ids unless store_pairs is true.
radius should be >= 0 (conventional).
result must be a valid RangeQueryResult.

functions.name: faiss::InvertedListScanner::iterate_codes_range
functions.signature: virtual void faiss::InvertedListScanner::iterate_codes_range(InvertedListsIterator* iterator, float radius, RangeQueryResult& result, size_t& list_size) const
functions.description: Like scan_codes_range but consumes codes via an InvertedListsIterator. Adds matches within radius to result and sets list_size to number of items scanned.
requirements: iterator must be valid and positioned for the current list.
radius should be >= 0 (conventional).
result must be valid.
list_size is an output returning how many codes were scanned.

functions.name: faiss::InvertedListScanner::~InvertedListScanner
functions.signature: virtual faiss::InvertedListScanner::~InvertedListScanner()
functions.description: Virtual destructor for the scanner.
requirements: Safe to delete derived scanners via base pointer.

functions.name: faiss::IndexIVFStats::IndexIVFStats
functions.signature: faiss::IndexIVFStats::IndexIVFStats()
functions.description: Constructs stats object for IVF searches and initializes all counters/timers to zero via reset().
requirements: None; immediately usable to collect stats.

functions.name: faiss::IndexIVFStats::reset
functions.signature: void faiss::IndexIVFStats::reset()
functions.description: Resets all statistics counters and timers to their initial (zero) values.
requirements: Safe to call any time to clear accumulated stats.

functions.name: faiss::IndexIVFStats::add
functions.signature: void faiss::IndexIVFStats::add(const faiss::IndexIVFStats& other)
functions.description: Accumulates statistics from another stats object into this one by summing counters and times.
requirements: other must be a valid stats object; adds its fields to this.

functions.name: faiss::IndexIVFFlat::IndexIVFFlat
functions.signature: faiss::IndexIVFFlat::IndexIVFFlat(faiss::Index* quantizer, size_t d, size_t nlist_, faiss::MetricType metric = faiss::METRIC_L2, bool own_invlists = true)
functions.description: Constructs an IVF-Flat index that stores raw float vectors in the inverted lists. A coarse quantizer (clustering index) selects lists, but vectors are not encoded beyond raw storage. Use this when you want exact storage within IVF lists and rely on the quantizer for preselection.
requirements: quantizer must be a valid, initialized faiss::Index pointer suitable as a coarse quantizer for the given dimensionality d.
d must be greater than 0 (vector dimensionality).
nlist_ must be greater than 0 (number of inverted lists).
metric selects the distance metric; if unspecified, defaults to METRIC_L2.
own_invlists controls ownership of inverted lists; if true, the index manages their lifetime.

functions.name: faiss::IndexIVFFlat::IndexIVFFlat
functions.signature: faiss::IndexIVFFlat::IndexIVFFlat()
functions.description: Default constructor for an IVF-Flat index. Members are constructed but not fully configured; a quantizer and training/configuration are typically required before adding/searching vectors.
requirements: The resulting object must be configured (e.g., set a quantizer, dimensionality, lists) and, if applicable, trained before use in add/search operations.

functions.name: faiss::IndexIVFFlat::add_core
functions.signature: void faiss::IndexIVFFlat::add_core(faiss::idx_t n, const float* x, const faiss::idx_t* xids, const faiss::idx_t* precomputed_idx, void* inverted_list_context = nullptr) override
functions.description: Low-level add routine that inserts n vectors into the inverted lists. For IVF-Flat, vectors are stored as raw floats. Typically called internally by higher-level add paths when list assignments are already known.
requirements: If n > 0, x must point to at least n * d floats (d is the index dimensionality).
xids must point to at least n identifiers (one per vector).
precomputed_idx must provide the target list number for each of the n vectors (length n).
inverted_list_context is optional and may be nullptr; if used, it must be a context object expected by the inverted list implementation.
The index dimensionality of the data in x must match the index’s d.

functions.name: faiss::IndexIVFFlat::encode_vectors
functions.signature: void faiss::IndexIVFFlat::encode_vectors(faiss::idx_t n, const float* x, const faiss::idx_t* list_nos, uint8_t* codes, bool include_listnos = false) const override
functions.description: Encodes n input vectors into the IVF-Flat code format. For IVF-Flat, codes contain the raw float values; optionally list numbers may be included when include_listnos is true. Intended for building or manipulating list storage directly.
requirements: If n > 0, x must point to at least n * d floats.
list_nos must provide a list number for each of the n vectors (length n).

codes must point to a preallocated buffer large enough to hold the encoded output for n vectors; for IVF-Flat this is at least n * d * sizeof(float), plus any space required if include_listnos is true.
The input dimensionality must match the index’s d.

functions.name: faiss::IndexIVFFlat::decode_vectors
functions.signature: void faiss::IndexIVFFlat::decode_vectors(faiss::idx_t n, const uint8_t* codes, const faiss::idx_t* list_nos, float* x) const override
functions.description: Decodes n IVF-Flat codes back into raw float vectors. For IVF-Flat, this reconstructs the original float values stored in the lists.
requirements: If n > 0, codes must point to at least the number of bytes required to represent n IVF-Flat codes (at minimum n * d * sizeof(float)).
list_nos must provide a list number for each of the n codes (length n).
x must point to a buffer large enough to store n * d floats.
The codes must have been produced by this or a compatible IVF-Flat index configuration.

functions.name: faiss::IndexIVFFlat::get_InvertedListScanner
functions.signature: faiss::InvertedListScanner* faiss::IndexIVFFlat::get_InvertedListScanner(bool store_pairs, const faiss::IDSelector* sel, const faiss::IVFSearchParameters* params) const override
functions.description: Creates and returns an inverted-list scanner object configured for IVF-Flat. The scanner iterates over postings within selected lists and computes distances according to the index’s metric.
requirements: store_pairs controls whether to store (list_no, offset) pairs during scanning; choose in accordance with the intended search path.
sel may be nullptr (no ID filtering) or point to a valid IDSelector used to filter candidates.
params may be nullptr or point to valid IVFSearchParameters to tune scanning behavior.
The returned scanner is owned by the caller and must be used/disposed according to FAISS conventions for InvertedListScanner (lifetime management as required by the implementation).

functions.name: faiss::IndexIVFFlat::reconstruct_from_offset
functions.signature: void faiss::IndexIVFFlat::reconstruct_from_offset(int64_t list_no, int64_t offset, float* recons) const override
functions.description: Reconstructs a vector stored at a given (list_no, offset) within the inverted lists and writes the raw float values to recons.
requirements: list_no must reference an existing inverted list in the index (0 <= list_no < nlist).
offset must be a valid entry index within the specified list.
recons must point to a buffer of at least d floats to receive the reconstructed vector.

functions.name: faiss::IndexIVFFlat::sa_decode
functions.signature: void faiss::IndexIVFFlat::sa_decode(faiss::idx_t n, const uint8_t* bytes, float* x) const override
functions.description: Decodes n serialized IVF-Flat codes from a contiguous byte array into raw float vectors. For IVF-Flat, this converts stored bytes back to floats without additional quantization.
requirements: If n > 0, bytes must point to at least the number of bytes required to represent n IVF-Flat codes (at minimum n * d * sizeof(float)).
x must point to a buffer large enough to store n * d floats.
The input bytes must correspond to codes produced by an IVF-Flat encoder compatible with this index’s configuration.

functions.name: faiss::IndexIVFFlatDedup::IndexIVFFlatDedup
functions.signature: faiss::IndexIVFFlatDedup::IndexIVFFlatDedup(faiss::Index* quantizer, size_t d, size_t nlist_, faiss::MetricType metric = faiss::METRIC_L2, bool own_invlists = true)
functions.description: Constructs an IVF-Flat index with deduplication support. The index maps identical vectors to the same stored instance via the instances multimap, reducing duplicate storage.
requirements: quantizer must be a valid, initialized faiss::Index pointer suitable for dimensionality d.
d must be greater than 0.
nlist_ must be greater than 0.
metric selects the distance metric; defaults to METRIC_L2.
own_invlists controls ownership of inverted lists; if true, the index manages their lifetime.

functions.name: faiss::IndexIVFFlatDedup::IndexIVFFlatDedup
functions.signature: faiss::IndexIVFFlatDedup::IndexIVFFlatDedup()
functions.description: Default constructor for an IVF-Flat-Dedup index. Initializes an empty index object and deduplication map; further configuration/training is required before use.
requirements: The resulting object must be configured (e.g., set a quantizer, dimensionality, lists) and trained as required before add/search operations.

functions.name: faiss::IndexIVFFlatDedup::train
functions.signature: void faiss::IndexIVFFlatDedup::train(faiss::idx_t n, const float* x) override
functions.description: Trains the IVF-Flat-Dedup index, also deduplicating the training set so that identical vectors are recognized and mapped accordingly.
requirements: If n > 0, x must point to at least n * d floats.
The input dimensionality must match the index’s d.
Training should be performed before adding vectors and search operations that require a trained quantizer.

functions.name: faiss::IndexIVFFlatDedup::add_with_ids
functions.signature: void faiss::IndexIVFFlatDedup::add_with_ids(faiss::idx_t n, const float* x, const faiss::idx_t* xids) override
functions.description: Adds n vectors with explicit IDs to the IVF-Flat-Dedup index, deduplicating identical vectors so they reference the same stored instance where applicable.
requirements: If n > 0, x must point to at least n * d floats.
xids must point to at least n identifiers (one per vector).
The input dimensionality must match the index’s d.
The index should be trained and properly configured before adding vectors.

functions.name: faiss::IndexIVFFlatDedup::search_preassigned
functions.signature: void faiss::IndexIVFFlatDedup::search_preassigned(faiss::idx_t n, const float* x, faiss::idx_t k, const faiss::idx_t* assign, const float* centroid_dis, float* distances, faiss::idx_t* labels, bool store_pairs, const faiss::IVFSearchParameters* params = nullptr, faiss::IndexIVFStats* stats = nullptr) const override
functions.description: Searches n query vectors with preassigned inverted-list information. For each query, candidates are taken from the provided list assignments, and top-k results are returned. Supports optional pair storage and search parameter tuning; collects stats if provided.
requirements: If n > 0, x must point to at least n * d floats.
k must be >= 1.
assign must provide preassigned list information for the queries; its layout/length must match what this method expects for preassignment (typically at least one list id per query).
centroid_dis must provide centroid distances corresponding to the preassignments, with a layout matching assign.
distances must point to a buffer of at least n * k floats for output.
labels must point to a buffer of at least n * k ids for output.
params may be nullptr or a valid pointer to IVFSearchParameters; stats may be nullptr or a valid pointer to IndexIVFStats.
store_pairs controls whether (list_no, offset) pairs are stored during search.

functions.name: faiss::IndexIVFFlatDedup::remove_ids
functions.signature: size_t faiss::IndexIVFFlatDedup::remove_ids(const faiss::IDSelector& sel) override
functions.description: Removes all entries whose IDs are selected by sel from the index. Returns the number of removed entries. Deduplication mappings are updated accordingly.
requirements: sel must be a valid IDSelector describing the set of IDs to remove.
Callers should be prepared for the index contents and instances map to change after removal.

functions.name: faiss::IndexIVFFlatDedup::range_search
functions.signature: void faiss::IndexIVFFlatDedup::range_search(faiss::idx_t n, const float* x, float radius, faiss::RangeSearchResult* result, const faiss::SearchParameters* params = nullptr) const override
functions.description: Range search is declared but not implemented for IndexIVFFlatDedup. Calling this will not perform a range search and is expected to be unsupported at runtime.
requirements: Callers should not rely on this function; it is not implemented.
If invoked, behavior is implementation-defined (likely throws/aborts) and should be avoided.

functions.name: faiss::IndexIVFFlatDedup::update_vectors
functions.signature: void faiss::IndexIVFFlatDedup::update_vectors(int nv, const faiss::idx_t* idx, const float* v) override
functions.description: Vector update is declared but not implemented for IndexIVFFlatDedup. Updating stored vectors is unsupported.
requirements: Callers should not call this function; it is not implemented.
If invoked, behavior is implementation-defined (likely throws/aborts) and should be avoided.

functions.name: faiss::IndexIVFFlatDedup::reconstruct_from_offset
functions.signature: void faiss::IndexIVFFlatDedup::reconstruct_from_offset(int64_t list_no, int64_t offset, float* recons) const override
functions.description: Reconstruction by (list_no, offset) is declared but not implemented for IndexIVFFlatDedup.
requirements: Callers should not call this function; it is not implemented.
If invoked, behavior is implementation-defined (likely throws/aborts) and should be avoided.

functions.name: faiss::IVFPQSearchParameters::IVFPQSearchParameters
functions.signature: faiss::IVFPQSearchParameters::IVFPQSearchParameters()
functions.description: Default constructor for IVFPQSearchParameters. Initializes scan_table_threshold to 0 and polysemous_ht to 0. Use to pass search-time parameters to IVFPQ-based searches.

functions.name: faiss::IVFPQSearchParameters::~IVFPQSearchParameters
functions.signature: faiss::IVFPQSearchParameters::~IVFPQSearchParameters()
functions.description: Destructor for IVFPQSearchParameters. Performs default cleanup; no special action required by callers.

functions.name: faiss::IndexIVFPQ::IndexIVFPQ
functions.signature: faiss::IndexIVFPQ::IndexIVFPQ(faiss::Index* quantizer, size_t d, size_t nlist, size_t M, size_t nbits_per_idx, faiss::MetricType metric = faiss::METRIC_L2, bool own_invlists = true)
functions.description: Constructs an inverted-file index with product quantization (IVFPQ). The provided quantizer defines the coarse quantization (nlist lists). PQ parameters are M sub-quantizers and nbits_per_idx bits per sub-quantizer. Suitable for approximate nearest neighbor search with L2 (default) or other supported metrics.
requirements: quantizer must point to a valid faiss::Index to serve as the coarse quantizer
d must match the dimensionality of vectors to be indexed
nlist is the number of coarse centroids (posting lists)
M must be the number of PQ sub-quantizers; code size equals M bytes when nbits_per_idx==8
nbits_per_idx must be compatible with ProductQuantizer (commonly 4..8)
If own_invlists is true, the instance takes ownership of the inverted lists

functions.name: faiss::IndexIVFPQ::IndexIVFPQ
functions.signature: faiss::IndexIVFPQ::IndexIVFPQ()
functions.description: Default constructor for IndexIVFPQ. Initializes an IVFPQ index with default-initialized members; additional setup is required before use.
requirements: Caller must properly configure and train the index (e.g., set quantizer, d, nlist, and train PQ) before adding or searching vectors

functions.name: faiss::IndexIVFPQ::encode_vectors
functions.signature: void faiss::IndexIVFPQ::encode_vectors(faiss::idx_t n, const float* x, const faiss::idx_t* list_nos, uint8_t* codes, bool include_listnos = false) const
functions.description: Encodes n input vectors into PQ codes, using the provided posting list ids (list_nos). Optionally includes list numbers in the output if include_listnos is true. Intended for bulk encoding consistent with the IVFPQ layout.
requirements: x must point to at least n * d floats
list_nos must point to at least n entries, each a valid posting list id for this index
codes must point to writable storage of at least n * code_size bytes (plus any listno storage if include_listnos is true)
include_listnos controls whether list ids are included in the produced code format

functions.name: faiss::IndexIVFPQ::decode_vectors
functions.signature: void faiss::IndexIVFPQ::decode_vectors(faiss::idx_t n, const uint8_t* codes, const faiss::idx_t* listnos, float* x) const
functions.description: Decodes n PQ codes back to approximate reconstructed vectors, given their corresponding posting list ids. Inverse operation of encode_vectors for batch data.
requirements: codes must point to at least n * code_size bytes
listnos must point to at least n posting list ids corresponding to codes
x must point to writable storage for at least n * d floats

functions.name: faiss::IndexIVFPQ::sa_decode
functions.signature: void faiss::IndexIVFPQ::sa_decode(faiss::idx_t n, const uint8_t* bytes, float* x) const
functions.description: Standalone decode of n codes (bytes) into reconstructed vectors x, without needing list ids. Useful when codebooks are sufficient to reconstruct.
requirements: bytes must point to at least n * code_size bytes
x must point to writable storage for at least n * d floats

functions.name: faiss::IndexIVFPQ::add_core
functions.signature: void faiss::IndexIVFPQ::add_core(faiss::idx_t n, const float* x, const faiss::idx_t* xids, const faiss::idx_t* precomputed_idx, void* inverted_list_context = nullptr)
functions.description: Core routine to add n vectors and their ids to the index. Optionally uses precomputed coarse assignments (precomputed_idx) and an inverted list context for customized list handling.
requirements: x must point to at least n * d floats
xids must point to at least n ids (or follow the base-class contract for id assignment)
If precomputed_idx is not null, it must point to at least n posting list ids for the vectors
inverted_list_context, if used, must be valid for the underlying inverted lists implementation

functions.name: faiss::IndexIVFPQ::add_core_o
functions.signature: void faiss::IndexIVFPQ::add_core_o(faiss::idx_t n, const float* x, const faiss::idx_t* xids, float* residuals_2, const faiss::idx_t* precomputed_idx = nullptr, void* inverted_list_context = nullptr)
functions.description: Variant of add_core that can also output second-level residuals if residuals_2 is provided. Accepts null precomputed_idx; otherwise similar to add_core.
requirements: x must point to at least n * d floats
xids must point to at least n ids
If residuals_2 is not null, it must point to writable storage sized for the produced residuals (size depends on encoder; at least n * d floats is safe if not otherwise specified)
If precomputed_idx is not null, it must point to at least n posting list ids
inverted_list_context, if used, must be valid for the inverted lists implementation

functions.name: faiss::IndexIVFPQ::train_encoder
functions.signature: void faiss::IndexIVFPQ::train_encoder(faiss::idx_t n, const float* x, const faiss::idx_t* assign)
functions.description: Trains the internal product quantizer (PQ) used by the IVFPQ index from n training vectors x, optionally using precomputed assignments to coarse centroids (assign).
requirements: x must point to at least n * d floats
If assign is provided, it must point to at least n assignments (posting list ids) corresponding to x
The index parameters (e.g., M, nbits_per_idx) must be set before training

functions.name: faiss::IndexIVFPQ::train_encoder_num_vectors
functions.signature: faiss::idx_t faiss::IndexIVFPQ::train_encoder_num_vectors() const
functions.description: Returns the number of training vectors the encoder expects or uses for training the PQ. Useful for sizing training sets.

functions.name: faiss::IndexIVFPQ::reconstruct_from_offset
functions.signature: void faiss::IndexIVFPQ::reconstruct_from_offset(int64_t list_no, int64_t offset, float* recons) const
functions.description: Reconstructs a single vector from its storage position given by (list_no, offset) within the inverted lists, and writes it to recons.
requirements: list_no must refer to a valid posting list in the index
offset must refer to a valid entry within the specified posting list
recons must point to writable storage for at least d floats

functions.name: faiss::IndexIVFPQ::find_duplicates
functions.signature: size_t faiss::IndexIVFPQ::find_duplicates(faiss::idx_t* ids, size_t* lims) const
functions.description: Scans the dataset to find exact duplicate vectors. Outputs groups of duplicate ids segmented by lims; returns the number of groups found.
requirements: ids must be pre-allocated with capacity at least ntotal
lims must be pre-allocated with capacity at least ntotal / 2 + 1
Caller must interpret ids[lims[i] .. lims[i+1]-1] as one group of duplicates

functions.name: faiss::IndexIVFPQ::encode
functions.signature: void faiss::IndexIVFPQ::encode(faiss::idx_t key, const float* x, uint8_t* code) const
functions.description: Encodes a single vector x into a PQ code using the specified posting list id (key).
requirements: x must point to at least d floats
code must point to writable storage of at least code_size bytes
key must be a valid posting list id for this index

functions.name: faiss::IndexIVFPQ::encode_multiple
functions.signature: void faiss::IndexIVFPQ::encode_multiple(size_t n, faiss::idx_t* keys, const float* x, uint8_t* codes, bool compute_keys = false) const
functions.description: Batch-encodes n vectors into PQ codes. If compute_keys is false, uses precomputed posting list ids in keys; otherwise computes keys internally.
requirements: x must point to at least n * d floats
codes must point to writable storage of at least n * code_size bytes
If compute_keys is false, keys must point to at least n valid posting list ids
If compute_keys is true, keys must point to writable storage for n entries to receive computed list ids

functions.name: faiss::IndexIVFPQ::decode_multiple
functions.signature: void faiss::IndexIVFPQ::decode_multiple(size_t n, const faiss::idx_t* keys, const uint8_t* xcodes, float* x) const
functions.description: Batch-decodes n PQ codes into reconstructed vectors, using the corresponding posting list ids in keys.
requirements: xcodes must point to at least n * code_size bytes
keys must point to at least n posting list ids
x must point to writable storage for at least n * d floats

functions.name: faiss::IndexIVFPQ::get_InvertedListScanner
functions.signature: faiss::InvertedListScanner* faiss::IndexIVFPQ::get_InvertedListScanner(bool store_pairs, const faiss::IDSelector* sel, const faiss::IVFSearchParameters* params) const
functions.description: Creates and returns an InvertedListScanner configured for this IVFPQ index, optionally storing pair information, applying an ID selector filter, and using search parameters.
requirements: sel may be null to disable id filtering; if non-null it must remain valid for the scanner's lifetime
params may be null; if provided, it should point to a compatible IVFSearchParameters (e.g., IVFPQSearchParameters) structure
Caller is responsible for managing the returned scanner pointer according to FAISS conventions

functions.name: faiss::IndexIVFPQ::precompute_table
functions.signature: void faiss::IndexIVFPQ::precompute_table()
functions.description: Builds the precomputed distance tables used to speed up query preprocessing for by-residual search with L2 metric, if enabled by configuration.
requirements: The index must be configured to allow/use precomputed tables (use_precomputed_table) for this to have effect

functions.name: faiss::initialize_IVFPQ_precomputed_table
functions.signature: void faiss::initialize_IVFPQ_precomputed_table(int& use_precomputed_table, const faiss::Index* quantizer, const faiss::ProductQuantizer& pq, faiss::AlignedTable<float>& precomputed_table, bool by_residual, bool verbose)
functions.description: Initializes precomputed distance tables for IVFPQ with by-residual search and L2 metric. Heuristically decides whether to enable tables unless forced via use_precomputed_table. Supports both generic and MultiIndexQuantizer-specific table layouts.
requirements: use_precomputed_table input values: -1 to force disable, 0 to choose heuristically, 1 for generic tables, 2 for MultiIndexQuantizer-specific tables
quantizer must point to the coarse quantizer used by the IVFPQ index
pq must be the ProductQuantizer used by the index
precomputed_table is an output container to be filled; it should be empty or ready to be overwritten
by_residual indicates whether residual coding is used; must match the index's configuration

functions.name: faiss::IndexIVFPQStats::IndexIVFPQStats

functions.name: faiss::IndexIVFPQStats::reset
functions.signature: void faiss::IndexIVFPQStats::reset()
functions.description: Resets all statistics counters and timers for IVFPQ searches, making the structure ready to collect fresh stats.

functions.name: faiss::IndexLSH::IndexLSH
functions.signature: faiss::IndexLSH::IndexLSH(faiss::idx_t d, int nbits, bool rotate_data = true, bool train_thresholds = false)
functions.description: Constructor for an LSH index that binarizes vectors based on the sign of their components. The index stores nbits per vector, can optionally apply a random rotation to inputs, and can optionally train thresholds instead of using 0. Use this to create an index with a fixed dimensionality d and a specified binary signature size.
requirements: d must be a positive dimension (in number of float components) for input vectors.
nbits must be a positive integer (number of bits per vector).
If rotate_data is true, the index will apply a random rotation internally before binarization (no caller action required).
If train_thresholds is true, callers should provide training data via train(...) before adding/searching to learn thresholds; otherwise thresholds default to 0.

functions.name: faiss::IndexLSH::IndexLSH
functions.signature: faiss::IndexLSH::IndexLSH()
functions.description: Default constructor for an LSH index. Creates an object with unspecified configuration until properly initialized (details are not shown in this header). Typically used only by internal or deserialization code.
requirements: Object may require further initialization (e.g., setting d/nbits) before use; details unknown.
Do not call search/train on an uninitialized instance; ensure required fields are set by the library before use (e.g., via read/deserialize).

functions.name: faiss::IndexLSH::apply_preprocess
functions.signature: const float* faiss::IndexLSH::apply_preprocess(faiss::idx_t n, const float* x) const
functions.description: Preprocesses input vectors prior to binarization. It may apply rotation and/or threshold-related transforms and resizes the data to the layout needed for signature computation. Returns a pointer to a buffer of size n * bits (as floats). The returned pointer may alias x; otherwise the caller must free it.
requirements: x must point to at least n * d floats, where d is the index dimensionality.
The returned pointer may be exactly x; if it is different from x, the caller must delete[] the returned buffer when done.
n must be non-negative; behavior for n == 0 is a no-op returning a valid pointer or nullptr depending on implementation (unknown).
The index must have been constructed with valid d and nbits prior to calling.

functions.name: faiss::IndexLSH::train
functions.signature: void faiss::IndexLSH::train(faiss::idx_t n, const float* x)
functions.description: Trains the LSH index on n vectors of dimension d. If train_thresholds is enabled, this learns thresholds used for binarization; otherwise training may be a no-op. Provide representative data to calibrate the transform.
requirements: x must point to at least n * d floats, where d is the index dimensionality.
Callers that set train_thresholds = true at construction should call train with sufficient data before searching/adding to ensure thresholds are learned.
n should be >= 0; exact minimum to perform meaningful training is implementation-defined (unknown).

functions.name: faiss::IndexLSH::search
functions.signature: void faiss::IndexLSH::search(faiss::idx_t n, const float* x, faiss::idx_t k, float* distances, faiss::idx_t* labels, const faiss::SearchParameters* params = nullptr) const
functions.description: Searches the index for the k nearest neighbors of n query vectors x. Outputs distances and corresponding labels (indices) for each query. Parameters may be provided via params or left null for defaults. The distance type/metric for LSH in this context is not specified here.
requirements: x must point to at least n * d floats, where d is the index dimensionality.
distances must point to a buffer of at least n * k floats to receive the results.
labels must point to a buffer of at least n * k indices (faiss::idx_t).
k must be >= 1 and typically <= ntotal (number of database vectors); behavior for k > ntotal follows Faiss conventions (unknown here).
If training is required (e.g., train_thresholds was enabled), train(...) should be called before search.
params may be nullptr; if non-null, it must outlive the call and match expected type for this index (faiss::SearchParameters or derived).
The index must contain added vectors prior to searching (addition interface not shown in this header).

functions.name: faiss::IndexLSH::transfer_thresholds
functions.signature: void faiss::IndexLSH::transfer_thresholds(faiss::LinearTransform* vt)
functions.description: Transfers the learned thresholds into a preprocessing stage represented by the provided LinearTransform and disables internal threshold training (unsets train_thresholds). Use this to externalize thresholding in a pipeline.
requirements: vt must be a valid, non-null pointer to a faiss::LinearTransform configured to accept the thresholds; dimension compatibility with the index is required (exact expectations not specified here).
After transfer, train_thresholds is unset; callers should not expect further training of thresholds inside the index.
Must be called on an initialized/trained index whose thresholds are available; otherwise effect is undefined (unknown).

functions.name: faiss::IndexLSH::~IndexLSH
functions.signature: faiss::IndexLSH::~IndexLSH()
functions.description: Destructor for the LSH index. Releases resources associated with the index instance.
requirements: Do not use the object after destruction.
All external pointers returned by apply_preprocess that required caller ownership must already have been freed by the caller.

functions.name: faiss::IndexLSH::sa_encode
functions.signature: void faiss::IndexLSH::sa_encode(faiss::idx_t n, const float* x, uint8_t* bytes) const
functions.description: Standalone codec: encodes n input vectors x into their binary signatures and writes them into bytes. Intended for direct encode/decode operations independent of the full index. Signatures represent the sign pattern of components (after any configured preprocessing).
requirements: x must point to at least n * d floats, where d is the index dimensionality.
bytes must point to a buffer large enough to hold n signatures; for LSH with nbits bits per vector, this is at least n * ceil(nbits / 8) bytes (inferred from binary packing).
n must be non-negative.
The index must be initialized with valid d and nbits; any required preprocessing parameters (e.g., rotation, thresholds) should be set/trained beforehand if intended.

functions.name: faiss::IndexLSH::sa_decode
functions.signature: void faiss::IndexLSH::sa_decode(faiss::idx_t n, const uint8_t* bytes, float* x) const
functions.description: Standalone codec: decodes n binary signatures from bytes back into float vectors x. Decoded values are +/-1 (not 0/1), consistent with the sign-based representation.
requirements: bytes must point to at least n * ceil(nbits / 8) bytes (inferred from binary packing with nbits bits per vector).
x must point to a buffer of at least n * d floats to receive decoded vectors.
n must be non-negative.
The index must be initialized with valid d and nbits so that decode can map the bit patterns back to d-dimensional +/-1 vectors.

functions.name: faiss::IndexHNSW::IndexHNSW
functions.signature: faiss::IndexHNSW::IndexHNSW(int d = 0, int M = 32, faiss::MetricType metric = faiss::METRIC_L2)
functions.description: Constructs an HNSW index with its own internal flat-like storage. Use this when you want IndexHNSW to own and manage the vector storage. Parameters select dimensionality, graph degree (M), and metric.
requirements: d must be >= 0 (vector dimensionality)
M should be > 0 (HNSW out-degree parameter)
metric must be a valid faiss::MetricType supported by the underlying distance computer

functions.name: faiss::IndexHNSW::~IndexHNSW
functions.signature: faiss::IndexHNSW::~IndexHNSW()
functions.description: Destructor for IndexHNSW. Releases resources associated with the HNSW structure and, if owned, the underlying storage.
requirements: The storage pointer, if not owned by this instance (own_fields == false), must be managed by the caller to avoid double free

functions.name: faiss::IndexHNSW::add
functions.signature: void faiss::IndexHNSW::add(faiss::idx_t n, const float* x)
functions.description: Adds n vectors to the index and updates the HNSW graph accordingly. Uses the configured metric. May also initialize level-0 graph depending on init_level0 and keep_max_size_level0 settings.
requirements: If n > 0 then x must be non-null and point to a contiguous array of size n * d (row-major)
The index should be trained if the underlying storage requires training (e.g., PQ/SQ/IVF backends) before calling add
If IndexHNSWCagra::base_level_only is set (on that subclass), add must not be called (adds are disabled)
Thread-safety is not guaranteed; external synchronization is required for concurrent add calls

functions.name: faiss::IndexHNSW::train
functions.signature: void faiss::IndexHNSW::train(faiss::idx_t n, const float* x)
functions.description: Trains the underlying storage if needed (e.g., PQ/SQ codebooks). HNSW itself is non-parametric and generally does not require training.
requirements: If n > 0 then x must be non-null and point to a contiguous array of size n * d (row-major)
Call train before add when the chosen storage backend requires training (e.g., PQ/SQ). Calling train on already-trained storage is allowed

functions.name: faiss::IndexHNSW::search
functions.signature: void faiss::IndexHNSW::search(faiss::idx_t n, const float* x, faiss::idx_t k, float* distances, faiss::idx_t* labels, const faiss::SearchParameters* params = nullptr) const
functions.description: Performs k-NN search for n query vectors using the HNSW graph for accelerated traversal over the storage. Writes the top-k distances and labels per query.

functions.description: Performs k-NN search for n query binary vectors of dimension d (bits). Returns up to k nearest neighbors per query. If fewer than k results exist for a query, remaining labels are set to -1. Distances are integer (distance_t) and returned in the distances array.
requirements: If n > 0, x must point to at least n * (d / 8) bytes.
k must be >= 0 (inferred); distances and labels must have capacity for n * k elements when k > 0.
distances must point to at least n * k int32_t elements when k > 0.
labels must point to at least n * k faiss::idx_t elements when k > 0.
params may be nullptr or a valid pointer to search parameters supported by the concrete index (unknown specifics).
If the index requires training, it must be trained and contain data (ntotal > 0) to return results (inferred).

functions.name: faiss::IndexBinary::search_ex
functions.signature: virtual void faiss::IndexBinary::search_ex(faiss::idx_t n, const void* x, faiss::NumericType numeric_type, faiss::idx_t k, int32_t* distances, faiss::idx_t* labels, const faiss::SearchParameters* params = nullptr) const
functions.description: Extended search entrypoint that accepts a typed payload. Only NumericType::UInt8 is supported and is forwarded to search; otherwise it throws.
requirements: numeric_type must be faiss::NumericType::UInt8; otherwise the function throws.
If n > 0, x must point to at least n * (d / 8) bytes of uint8_t data.
k must be >= 0 (inferred); distances and labels must have capacity for n * k elements when k > 0.
params may be nullptr or a valid pointer (unknown specifics).

functions.name: faiss::IndexBinary::range_search
functions.signature: virtual void faiss::IndexBinary::range_search(faiss::idx_t n, const uint8_t* x, int radius, faiss::RangeSearchResult* result, const faiss::SearchParameters* params = nullptr) const
functions.description: Performs radius (range) search for n query binary vectors, returning all database vectors with distance strictly less than radius. Distances are integer internally but converted to float inside RangeSearchResult; only distances < radius are returned. Many IndexBinary implementations may not implement range_search.
requirements: If n > 0, x must point to at least n * (d / 8) bytes.
result must be a valid, non-null pointer ready to receive results.
radius is compared with strict inequality (distance < radius); radius = 0 returns no results, radius = 1 returns exact matches (as stated).
params may be nullptr or a valid pointer to search parameters (unknown specifics).
Function may not be implemented by some derived classes (as stated).

functions.name: faiss::IndexBinary::assign
functions.signature: void faiss::IndexBinary::assign(faiss::idx_t n, const uint8_t* x, faiss::idx_t* labels, faiss::idx_t k = 1) const
functions.description: Returns the indices (labels) of the k nearest neighbors for n query vectors, equivalent to search but only outputs labels. Pads with -1 when fewer than k results exist.
requirements: If n > 0, x must point to at least n * (d / 8) bytes.
labels must point to at least n * k elements.
k must be >= 0 (inferred).
Underlying index must support search and be in a valid state (e.g., trained if needed, and possibly non-empty) (inferred).

functions.name: faiss::IndexBinary::reset
functions.signature: virtual void faiss::IndexBinary::reset() = 0
functions.description: Removes all elements from the database, resetting the index contents.
requirements: No arguments; may invalidate previous IDs; behavior beyond clearing contents depends on the implementation (unknown).

functions.name: faiss::IndexBinary::remove_ids
functions.signature: virtual size_t faiss::IndexBinary::remove_ids(const faiss::IDSelector& sel)
functions.description: Removes all vectors whose IDs are selected by sel. Not supported by all indexes.
requirements: sel must be a valid selector object defining which IDs to remove.
Function may not be supported by some derived classes; callers should be prepared for errors or no-ops depending on implementation (as stated).

functions.name: faiss::IndexBinary::reconstruct
functions.signature: virtual void faiss::IndexBinary::reconstruct(faiss::idx_t key, uint8_t* recons) const
functions.description: Reconstructs the stored vector for a given ID into recons. May not be defined for some indexes.
requirements: recons must point to at least (d / 8) bytes.
key should refer to an existing vector ID in the index; otherwise behavior is implementation-defined (unknown).
Function may not be supported by all indexes (as stated).
